instructions: Deliver the assigned user behavior through its actual entry point, source operation and visible result. Record any remaining integration separately.
Use the assigned write scope. Consume completed dependencies promptly, and keep independent ready work moving.
Select verification for the changed behavior. Reuse results only while their code and environment remain applicable; retain the established release checks.
Inspect affected secondary pages and states as well as the primary screen. Record unvisited states as unknown, and separate component, browser and physical-device evidence.
Use profile evidence to propose one attributable improvement at a time. Preserve the user's scope, authorization and acceptance criteria.
